statePersistence.pageDesc: State persistence writes the runtime state of circuit breakers, load balancers and rate limiters to Redis, H2 or file storage. Every action on this page takes effect immediately; there is no draft to save.
statePersistence.currentTierDesc: The storage tier actually in effect, determined by priority and health checks.
statePersistence.switchTierDesc: After switching, new state is written to the target tier; existing state is not migrated automatically and must be synced manually.
statePersistence.switchTierConfirm: Switch to {tier}? New state will be written to this tier; running syncs are not interrupted.
statePersistence.tiersDesc: Live health of each storage tier. Display only — it cannot be modified here.
statePersistence.actionsDesc: All actions take effect immediately on click; nothing needs saving.
statePersistence.detailsDesc: Persisted state entries. Recovery can be run on individual records.

messages.loadFailed: Failed to load status. Using default values
messages.tiersRefreshFailed: Failed to refresh storage tier status
messages.recoverNotSupported: This state type cannot be recovered individually
messages.alreadyUsingTier: This storage tier is already in use
